title: Nova Sonic voice assistant
description: How the Nova Sonic voice assistant speaks and behaves in a meeting.
appliesText: A saved change applies to the next meeting the voice assistant joins; a meeting it is already in keeps the settings it started with.

systemPrompt.title: System prompt
systemPrompt.description: How the assistant introduces itself and answers. The prompt mode decides how this combines with the shipped prompt.

enumLabels.inject: Inject: add this prompt to the shipped one
enumLabels.replace: Replace: use this prompt instead of the shipped one

voiceId.title: Voice ID
voiceId.description: The voice the assistant speaks with.

endpointingSensitivity.title: Endpointing sensitivity
endpointingSensitivity.description: How quickly the assistant decides a speaker has finished. HIGH answers soonest.

meetingMode.title: Meeting mode
meetingMode.description: Group and Translator take effect only when the Virtual Participant is deployed with its voice assistant activation mode set to always_active.

translatorMutePhrases.title: Mute trigger phrases
translatorMutePhrases.description: Comma-separated phrases that pause translation when spoken.

translatorUnmutePhrases.title: Unmute trigger phrases
translatorUnmutePhrases.description: Comma-separated phrases that resume translation when spoken.

groupMeetingMode.title: Group meeting mode (legacy)
groupMeetingMode.description: Read only when no meeting mode is set. Set the meeting mode instead.
